eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CIVIL DANGER WARNING for the following counties or areas: Hawaii, HI; at 10:45 PM on JUL 25, 2026 Effective until 10:45 AM JUL 26, 2026. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Hawaii County Civil Defense: Hawaii Fire Dept issued Wildfire WARNING for Kawaihae Village Subdivision. Those in the affected area must EVACUATE NOW! Open shelters: Waimea Community Center. Evacuate East on Kawaihae Road to Waimea.
